chunks: Even if you are eager to guide them, God does not surely guide those who have gone astray: They will have no one to help them.

key_terms.يُضِلْ: to cause to go astray / to be astray

ai.seo_question: Why does God not guide those who are astray even if we try to guide them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the interplay between divine decree (al-Jabr) and human effort (al-Tafwid), clarifying that the Prophet’s intense striving does not guarantee guidance for those whose hearts are sealed by their own choices. It underscores that divine guidance is contingent upon the recipient's readiness, and those who persist in deviation find no intercessor or helper but themselves. This reinforces the concept that while the Imams and Prophet are the means of guidance, the ultimate bestowal of light remains with Allah.
